interface.normalization: DC removal then block-RMS gain; gain supplied/configured by CPU
interface.output_format: FFT complex signed values plus uint32/uint64 power bins

fixed_point_recommendation.fft_scaling: block floating point or 1-bit/stage; retain exponent metadata
fixed_point_recommendation.rationale: For signed Q1.15 input and coefficients, each product is ~Q2.30. A 65-tap FIR needs ceil(log2(65))=7 guard bits plus sign, so 40 bits prevents worst-case accumulation overflow. FFT growth is log2(N) bits; do not freeze the final width until RTL scaling and crest-factor tests exist.
